title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12223__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12223__PART_2_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12223__PART_2_). This Indian Standard (Part 2), which is identical with ISO 8063/2 : 1986 'Information processing — Data interchange on 6.30 mm (0.25 in) wide magnetic tape cartridge using IMFM recording at 252 ftpmm (6400 ftpi)~-Part 2: Track format and method of recording for data interchange in start/stop mode', issued by the international Organization for Standardizatiori (ISO) was adopted by the Business Machines and Calculators Sectional Committee (LTDC 24) and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
